independent_confirmation.decision: Review the small paired pilot before authorizing independent confirmation

interpretation.comparator: Passive 58-column global model, old endpoint fit, issue baseline, 13-column residual, and state-interaction residual on each exactly replayed v11 flow.
interpretation.matching: Chosen MAE/MSE and aggregate gain errors compare identical supported records within each endpoint; availability and missing truth remain explicit.
interpretation.endpoints: 58-column/base global predictions have no same-car or fixed300 target. Their direction against fixed300 is a cross-endpoint proxy only.
interpretation.raw: Zero-duration raw global response is separate from analytic zero. Positive-duration day gains lack paired truth and are descriptive.
interpretation.scope: Twelve development states at one seed; no deployed candidate control comparison or independent confirmation.
interpretation.interactions: State 0/1 changes compare anchors under one fitted flow. Fixed-weight deletion is an action-contrast decomposition, not a separately refitted model; truth is not required to flip sign.
